checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Bright, sunny gym with ordinary people, light exercise, plants; no bodybuilding.

must.item: Text reads exactly the four lines
must.why: Address and hours garbled ('Eaenar hhan', 'Sat - 6h 8am-4'), extra garbage line 'IFIM', 'Northside Gym' sometimes malformed.

must.item: All four lines visible together for the final 5 seconds
must.why: Panel is semi-transparent and starts fading in around 4s; text is only partially formed; lines are garbled and the weekend line is cut off at 7s.

must.item: Large, high-contrast, inside frame, no overlap/clipped characters
must.why: Text is moderately sized and inside the frame, but characters are distorted and clipped, the panel is translucent, and an extra junk line appears.
Vertical and 10s with audio present, but the mood and absence of voice can't be judged.

exact_text.read_as: Northside Gym / NorthsideGym / Northside Gynn (varies by frame, partly distorted)

faults.what: Address line is garbled gibberish instead of '18 Cedar Road'
Hours lines are misspelled or cut off ('Fll', 'Sat - 6h 8am-4', '4Om'), wrong dashes and wrong end times
Extra garbled line ('IFIM') above the title that the user did not ask for
Text morphs and shifts between frames and is unstable, not stable for 5s
Panel is translucent, so people show through the text, which lowers contrast; the text is also fairly small

summary: The welcoming gym scene is good, but the on-screen details are garbled and unstable, with a wrong address, wrong hours and a junk extra line, so the promo is unusable.
